title: Limit of absolute rotation quotients
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be differentiable at $x\in\mathbb R^n$ with derivative $L:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $y\in\mathbb R^n$. As $\theta$ tends to $0$ through positive values, $|f(\cos\theta\,x+\sin\theta\,y)-f(x)|/\theta$ tends to $|L(y)|$.
replaced: Let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ have derivative $L$ at $x$, and let $y\in\mathbb R^n$. Then $|f(\cos\theta\,x+\sin\theta\,y)-f(x)|/\theta\to|L(y)|$ as $\theta\to0^+$.
